description: Queue a draft to post at a later time, to every account in it. Call it only after the user said yes to this post and this time. Answers one delivery per account in state queued; a warning on a delivery means that account’s connection will lapse before then and the user should reconnect it. Refused when the time is further ahead than the plan schedules (usage_get says how far).

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key (8 to 200 chars, e.g. UUID). Reusing it after a timeout returns the same jobs and never double-posts.

scheduledAt.description: Future UTC timestamp ending in Z (e.g. 2026-11-06T14:00:00Z), converted from the workspace time zone (see usage_get).

version.description: Draft version last read; mismatched versions are refused.

name: schedule
title: Schedule a post
